shadowSentences: I enjoy reading books every evening.
My favorite hobby is painting landscapes.
Traveling to new places is always exciting.
I love trying different kinds of food.
Listening to music helps me relax and unwind.
Walking in nature brings me a sense of peace.
I often volunteer at the local animal shelter.
Cooking new recipes challenges my creativity in the kitchen.
Learning a new language can be both fun and rewarding.
Spending time with family strengthens our bonds and creates memories.

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about travel experiences.
questions: Q1: Can you share a memorable travel experience you had?
Q2: What challenges did you face during this trip?
Q3: How do you feel about the impact of travel on personal growth?
Q4: What advice would you give to someone planning their first trip?

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about exercise habits.
questions: Q1: What type of exercise do you enjoy the most?
Q2: Have you ever struggled to maintain a consistent exercise routine?
Q3: In your opinion, how important is physical fitness for overall health?
Q4: What tips would you offer to someone trying to get into a fitness routine?

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about study techniques.
questions: Q1: What study techniques have worked well for you?
Q2: Have you encountered any difficulties while studying?
Q3: How do you think effective study habits affect academic performance?
Q4: What recommendations would you give for improving study skills?
